lines.text: Ahaziah falls through a lattice in Samaria and sends messengers to ask Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, if he will recover.
The messengers return and describe a hairy man with a leather belt, and the king says it was Elijah the Tishbite.
The king sends a captain with fifty men to Elijah on a hill, and fire from heaven consumes them.
The king sends a second captain, and then a third who begs on his knees that the king would be healed.

wrong_details.wrong: that the king would be healed
wrong_details.true: that his life and the lives of his fifty men would be precious

lines.text: Elijah goes down and tells Ahaziah he will surely die, and Jehu becomes king of Israel after him.
